special.name: /guess-the-number
special.info: You need to first set the permissions in your server settings for this command and after that add them under "adminRoles" here.

content.name: adminRoles
content.description: Every role that can manage game sessions.

content.name: startMessage

default.title: Guess the Number - Game started
default.description: Guess a number between %min% and %max%. Good luck!

content.description: Message that gets send when a new round gets started

content.name: endMessage

default.title: Guess the Number - Game ended
default.description:
Good game everyone!
The winner is %winner%.
The number was **%number%**.
There were around **%guessCount% guesses** in total.

content.description: Message that gets send when a round ends

params.name: guessCount
params.description: Count of guesses in this game session

content.name: higherLowerReactions
content.description: If enabled, the bot will react with ⬇ (if the guess is higher than the correct number) or with ⬆ (if the guess is lower than the correct number) on wrong guesses. If disabled, the bot will just react with ❌ on wrong guesses.

content.name: enableLeaderboard
content.description: If enabled, a leaderboard button is shown on new game messages and user statistics (wins, guesses) are tracked.
